title: Response spectrum close modes: SRSS versus CQC
source: Der Kiureghian (1981), A response spectrum method for random vibration analysis of MDF systems, Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics 9, 1–18; the two-mode CQC correlation formula and modal combination are evaluated independently.
